tests.name: 1. unauthenticated /mcp: 401 with the resource metadata challenge
2. PRM resource is the MCP URL exactly; one authorization server
3. AS metadata advertises CIMD, `none`, iss and S256 only
4. authorization responses include iss
5. /token takes form encoding; a dead refresh token is invalid_grant
6. a cold server answers discovery, registration and token within 10 s, refresh within 30 s
6. the deployed stage answers discovery, registration and token within 10 s, refresh within 30 s
7. the PC client's loopback redirect matches any port on localhost and 127.0.0.1
8a. static clients: authorize inside their window only
8b. DCR: the vendor's exact redirect registers inside a window, never outside; a foreign redirect closes it
8e. DCR as Grok sends it (no application_type) registers inside a Grok window
8f. a request with the openid scope (as Grok sends) completes after one consent
8g. a vendor asking for every advertised scope (as Grok does) gets read and write after one consent
8c. CIMD: the vendor's document works inside its window only, with its exact redirect
8d. Claude Code (direct): CIMD with a loopback redirect on any port
9. PKCE plain and a missing challenge are refused with the error page
10. reusing an authorization code fails and revokes what it issued
11. refresh reuse within 30 s returns the same pair; after 30 s it revokes the grant
11c. without offline_access (as ChatGPT asks) the grant outlives the owner's consent session
11b. Gemini: its per-user redirect is matched by rule and pinned, and its refresh token is fixed (§4.5, §5.3)
12. an invalid redirect_uri or client_id yields the error page, not a redirect
13. CIMD URL shapes and targets outside the rules are refused
14. DCR fields outside the allow-list are refused; RFC 7592 endpoints are 404
15. route inventory: nothing outside routes.allow.txt answers on {host}
tests.note: runs alone with the deployed timeout

tests.name: 15b. route inventory: nothing outside routes.admin.allow.txt answers on admin.{host}
16. /mcp ignores cookies and rejects a browser Origin
17. both discovery paths return the same metadata with the host's issuer
18. failures on reg, auth and token are byte-identical with and without an open window
19. consent needs the window's pair cookie or its pair code
20. MRTR requestState: tampered, expired, replayed, other-grant or other-argument state falls back
20b. MRTR through /mcp: only a fresh, untampered state for this grant and these arguments is an answer
